prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished believable three-dimensional fantasy RPG inventory product render on a genuinely transparent alpha background. One isolated complete item, centered diagonal from lower left to upper right, occupies about 80% of square canvas with clear margins. Three-quarter view, studio lighting from upper left, crisp readable silhouette at 48px, rich realistic grain and material detail. No floor, scene, pedestal, background shadow, frame, text, logo, hands, wearer, decorative particles or extra objects. No gemstone, no crystal, no glow or magical charge: socket must be visibly EMPTY with dark brown wood interior and open negative space. Subject: Oak Staff. A full 180cm two-handed resin-dark chestnut oak staff with pronounced rich woodgrain, long slender continuous shaft and a long central double-hand grip carved with flowing interlace channels. At the upper end a clearly EMPTY cage of forged cobalt metal: four curved muted blue-gray metal ribs form an open hollow crown with wide gaps, brown wooden socket base, no core or object inside. Cobalt bracing collars and heel ferrule with restrained engraved edges, tiny practical rivets. Glossy natural resin finish and skilled woodworking. Shaft about seven times the crown height, long lower shaft extends well below grip. Entirely unlit, metallic highlights only.
